_doc: C1b (PLAN-1b-1, G-MOCK): live selectors for window-nav-search.html (zero state, laser mode) and window-nav-results.html (All summary for 'half', gamepad mode, focus on the Top Hit). Run with --flags wp.c1b,wp.p3,wp.c1a (results: and wp.c2a for the Software cell; its provider lists programs only after Home has rendered once, so the pre visits Home). Unmapped by design: the results mockup's 'scope' (the 64 px track is P4's ::after of Steam's tab row, not an element; its segments are measured by the gates' E-SEG criterion), the zero state's 'window' (C1a's, PLAN-1a-3). The live Recent Games cell is the whole 160 x 180 target, as in the mockup. Store tiles are Steam's own (177 x 82 art on a 189 px pitch), the mockup's are crops of them (180 x 84). Measured on purpose against the live hit boxes, as C1a-cmp.json does: Back (80 box vs the 60 circle: -10, -10, +20, +20), the field (80 vs 64: -8, -8, +16, +16), Steam's arrows (80 vs 60) and the More circle (80 vs 60); the ornament members are C1a's 84 px rows (dy -12, dh +24, C1a-cmp.json). The snapshot and the scrim cover the whole 720 px surface (the glass clips them at 656), the mockup draws them inside the 656 glass: dh +64.

window-nav-search.pre: (async()=>{const W=L.surface('main');const kb=()=>{try{W.SteamClient.OpenVR.Keyboard.Hide()}catch(e){}};L.nav('/library/tab/AllGames');await L.sleep(1200);L.click('main','#header %{SearchBox}');await L.sleep(1300);kb();for(const q of ['dolphin','tomb raider','half']){__LGS_RT.search.setQuery(q);await L.sleep(1700);kb();}__LGS_RT.search.setQuery('');await L.sleep(1500);kb();return L.route()+' '+__LGS_RT.search.recent().slice(0,3).join('|')})()
